features.name: Subscription billing feature set
features.description: New feature that provides tools to manage subscriptions with proper contract documentation, including management of terms, services, billing frequency, renewals, and termination conditions.

features.name: Recurring billing process
features.description: Allows you to run the recurring billing process in a way that can be adapted to your billing rhythm and get subscription bills on time.

features.name: Subscription revenue recognition
features.description: Enables recognition of subscription revenue that follows your reporting cadence in finance.

features.name: Usage-based billing
features.description: Enables running usage-based billing for subscriptions by importing quantities and prices for the recurring billing process via CSV file or custom API.
caveats: requires CSV file or custom API for importing quantities and prices
